title: Product Photography for Charleston, SC Businesses
metaTitle: Product Photography for Charleston, SC Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product photography for Charleston makers and retailers: catalog, lifestyle and detail images for online stores, Amazon and ads, shot by TDM's US-based team.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Charleston businesses that sell online: clean catalog images, styled lifestyle scenes and close detail shots, retouched and delivered in the sizes each channel requires. The method is simple and worth stating at the start. TDM's US-based team photographs your products, under controlled light for catalog work or in a real setting when the image calls for one. Retouching and export are then handled at our operations office in Lahore, and you sign off the shot list and art direction before any picture is taken.

sections.heading: Why Charleston retailers need a second shop window
paragraphs: A great deal of Charleston retail starts with someone walking past. A visitor steps into a boutique on King Street, a stall in the City Market or a gallery in the French Quarter, buys something, and flies home. Whether that person ever buys again depends on the online store, and the online store depends on its pictures. A shop that looks beautiful in person and flat on a phone loses the repeat order.

The city also has makers who never had a shopfront: jewellers, candle and soap makers, specialty food producers, clothing labels and furniture and home goods workshops spread from the upper peninsula to Park Circle and Summerville. They sell through their own sites, through marketplaces and through wholesale buyers who ask for consistent product images before placing an order.

sections.heading: What a shoot delivers
paragraphs: We agree the full set list before anything is photographed, so every product leaves with the same angles and nothing is missed.
bullets: Studio catalog images on white or colored backgrounds, consistent across the whole range.
Lifestyle scenes built with props and sets that suit the product and the customer.
Macro shots of texture, stitching, finish and ingredients.
Image sets that follow the rules of Amazon and other marketplaces.
Retouching, color correction and background cleanup.
Files cropped and exported for your store, marketplaces, email and paid ads.

sections.heading: Preparing for the shoot
paragraphs: A little planning saves a lot of trouble. Set aside one clean, undamaged sample of each item and each color, with any packaging you want shown. Fragile pieces such as glass, ceramics and framed work should be handled as little as possible and photographed early in the session. Perishable food needs its timing agreed, with sealed packaging on hand for the catalog images, and you should tell us about anything sensitive to heat. One-of-a-kind items, antiques and large furniture are often best photographed where they stand, and the session can be planned around that.

The Charleston look itself needs a decision. If your brand leans on the Lowcountry, the images can be made in a real setting, such as your shop, a porch or a kitchen you have permission to use, or on a set built with honest materials: weathered wood, linen, oyster shell, greenery. We will not pass off a set as a real location. Whichever you choose, the catalog images and the lifestyle images are matched in color and light during retouching so the two sit together on a page.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina, though not in Charleston, and can answer questions about preparing a shoot. The photography is carried out by TDM's team in the United States, and the images are retouched at our operations office in Lahore and delivered online.

faqs.q: Who takes the photographs for a Charleston shop?
faqs.a: TDM's US-based team does. They work from the shot list you approved, and the retouching follows at our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: Can you photograph my products for Amazon and my own store at once?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan one session to produce white-background images that meet marketplace rules, plus lifestyle and detail images for your own site and ads, so the product looks the same wherever a customer finds it.

faqs.q: Can products be photographed in a real Charleston setting?
faqs.a: Yes, when the image needs it and you have permission to use the place. Catalog and marketplace images are still better made under controlled light, so most projects combine the two.

faqs.q: What does product photography cost for a Charleston shop?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of products, the number of images per product and how much styling the scenes need. We quote after a free consultation and an agreed shot list.

faqs.q: How long until I receive the images?
faqs.a: That depends on the brief, the number of products and the retouching involved. Dates for shooting, retouching and delivery are agreed in the plan before the session is booked.
